item.title: The Great Lakes are ideal for wind energy. So where is it?

item.title: The AI boom has plunged a small Pennsylvania town into chaos

item.description: Licensed therapist Leslie Davenport advises a reader who loves to travel, but worries about its impact on the planet.

item.title: The growing allure — and danger — of glacier tourism
item.description: I study glaciers. I'm deeply worried about the growth of ice cave tourism.

item.title: Long overlooked as crucial to life, fungi start to get their due
item.description: Fungi create soil, sequester vast amounts of carbon, and contribute $55 trillion to the global economy, but knowledge about them is scarce. Now, mycologists are pushing to get the international scientific community to recognize fungi on the same level as plants and animals.
